Khṛgala, or, as the Paippalāda recension of the Atharvaveda has it, Khugila, is an obscure expression found in two passages only--once in the Rigveda, and once in the Atharvaveda. In the former the meaning ‘crutch’ seems required; in the latter Sāyaṇa glosses it by ‘armour’ (tanu-trāṇa), but the sense is quite uncertain.
Foot notes iii. 9. 3.
ii. 39, 4.
Cf. Bloomfield, Hymns of the Atharvaveda, 340; Whitney, Translation of the Atharvaveda, 98.
iii. 9. 3.
